prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice feeding your pet while desktop assets build!"]
1: ["Select Custom Photo"]
2: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet anytime.", "Right-click pet for main menu; Drag to reposition; Double-click to chat."]
3: ["Your pet lives in your system tray. Click the tray icon anytime to show or hide your pet!"]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Environment", "Downloading animated assets and initializing desktop graphics engine..."]
5: ["Playful pets pop up frequently; Calm pets stay quiet in the background while you work.", "Behavior Trait Info"]
6: ["Signing into your registered account automatically syncs and restores your existing pets from the cloud.", "Returning owner? Log in to recover your saved companions."]
7: ["Choose Your Pet Path", "Adopt a ready-made companion or create a custom pet from your own photos."]
8: ["Adoption Official!", "Your pet certificate is signed. Completing setup unlocks the desktop quick-call widget.", "Unlocked: Quick Call Desktop Widget"]
9: ["We will send a system notification as soon as your desktop pet is ready to play."]
